description: Deterministic checkpoint-based tool-calling benchmark for the authentication deliberation fixture.

cases.description: The model should turn the opening topic into an item claim from an empty session.
cases.user_message: We need to decide the authentication approach for the public API and the admin dashboard before beta. Draft that as the opening deliberation item.

cases.description: Early-state proposal drafting should create a proposal under the main item.
cases.user_message: Draft a proposal to use a third-party OIDC provider for all authentication.

cases.description: Explicit relation requests should call the relation tool with exact source and target ids.
cases.user_message: Draft a support relation from fact-public-api-clients to prop-jwt.

cases.description: A natural-language block should at least materialize the stance draft.
cases.user_message: I block prop-jwt because revocation is too hard. Draft my stance.

cases.description: Pure process questions should use the no_structured_action escape hatch.
cases.user_message: What does /submit do after drafts are ready?

cases.description: The model should resolve the superseded OIDC proposal as withdrawn when explicitly asked.
cases.user_message: Withdraw prop-oidc. We want to split workforce auth from public API auth instead of forcing one mechanism everywhere.

cases.description: After withdrawing the old proposal, the model should draft the replacement hybrid proposal.
cases.user_message: Draft a new hybrid proposal: use OIDC for workforce and admin auth, provider-backed JWTs for the public API, and a thin adapter layer so we can swap vendors later.

cases.description: Direct consent language should become a stance on the hybrid proposal.
Later-stage relation drafting should remain reliable under richer fixture state.
cases.user_message: Draft an attack relation from cond-break-glass to fact-provider-outage-risk.
